mechanism_claims.claim_text: RP444 showed immediate and concentration-dependent bactericidal activity against P. aeruginosa 19660_Xen5 in IVIS time-kill assays; the paper frames membrane disruption as a suggested interpretation, not a directly proven membrane assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote the suggested membrane-function explanation to direct membrane mechanism without a direct membrane integrity/permeabilization assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Selected dHDPs had MBEC values against Gram-positive and Gram-negative biofilm bacteria, supporting a biofilm-eradication activity phenotype rather than a molecular biofilm mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MBEC rows are retained in activity_toxicity_evidence; no additional molecular mechanism is inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 did not develop resistance to RP444 after 21 passages under the reported selection protocol, while gentamicin resistance appeared as growth at 1024 times MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Assay supports resistance-development behavior, not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Topical RP444 reduced murine P. aeruginosa keratitis clinical scores, bacterial burden, and MPO-associated inflammatory cell infiltration at source-reported doses and time points.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RP444 in murine P. aeruginosa keratitis model
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-image exact values beyond text/caption values are not invented.

extraction_scope: Worker-6 re-adjudicated the prior mechanism placeholders into paper-specific source-located phenotype/mechanism-scope claims without overclaiming direct molecular mechanism.
